title: Privacy-preserving GA4 web and product analytics

acceptance_criteria.outcome: Retain GA4 through a provider-independent no-throw interface, closed reusable definitions and mock/no-op adapters without a new analytics dependency.
Emit exactly one normalized static-title page_view per committed meaningful navigation, including initial grant/back/forward, excluding redirects, query-only changes and sensitive routes.
Allowlisted custom and automatic outbound metadata contain no prohibited personal/financial data, raw dynamic IDs, query/hash contents or unsafe referrers.
Basic opt-in and reachable preferences enforce denial/revocation across tabs and pending work without breaking authentication, drafts or AI consent.
Catalog P events cover existing important web journeys with explicit intent/persistence semantics and documented reserved unsupported milestones.

One authoritative web producer and operation dedup prevent repeated callbacks/retries/double clicks inflating success; failures, cancellations and unknown writes never fabricate success or replay financial writes.
No account/email-derived analytics identity; logout/switch/expiry clear context and reset consented owned browser identity with stale-account callbacks suppressed.
Development/test collection is disabled, staging uses a separate property, production is explicitly configured, and blocked/failed analytics never interrupts product functionality.
GA Admin changes are documented, coordinated with marketing and separately authorized; no historical deletion or irreversible filter activation without approval.

Catalog schemas/source/UAT mappings, acquisition/activation/engagement/retention/reliability formulas and limitations are maintained; mobile/MCP definitions reusable without instrumenting those platforms.
Deterministic tests plus actual SDK outbound/DebugView verification establish acceptance; record missing evidence honestly and pass routed checks/reviews before release consideration.

implementation_approval.reference: User message 2026-11-24: approved. proceed next — approval of proposed plan; proceed with Phase 2 foundations. No production action authorized.

notes: Approved 2026-11-24. Phase 2 and 3 implemented locally. Source and intercepted fixture checks pass. Actual GA4 and reporting validation depend on a separately configured non-production property. Production settings, deployment and deletion remain separately authorized.
